main_body: Sci-fi control tower. A wide base with a sloped panel roof and a dark front wall with a double door, a narrow neck with a small screen, and an upper cabin with a sloped cap and a window band.
top_band: Light blue-grey sloped roof/cap panels at rows 8-17 on the upper cabin, and at rows 52-61 on the base. Both are wide trapezoids that sit above their front faces.
evidence: Reading the middle column, the base shows a roof band of about 10 rows (52-61) in light blue-grey with panel seams. A lighter edge line at rows 60-61 follows, then a dark eave row at about 62-63, then the front wall at rows 63-78 with a yellow stripe and an inset double door framed in dark. The upper cabin repeats this: a sloped cap at rows 8-17, a highlight at row 16-17, a dark band under it, and recessed windows at rows 18-28. Both horizontal surfaces are clearly visible from above, so it reads as 3/4 and no side face is drawn.

style.evidence: The candidate uses about 4 blue-grey steps, and the outline is a nearly colourless dark navy-black running around the whole silhouette, which gives a sticker look. The neck (rows 30-50) and the dark base wall are large flat fills with only a few dots. The roof panels are smooth with seam lines and have no per-tile highlights or grain. Most tiles carry about 2-5 colours, which is clearly thinner than the Beodeul houses with their per-tile roof scallops, plaster speckle and stone shading.
